description: This PHP class implements an interface for integrating GitHub issues with a bug tracking system. It manages connection setup, issue retrieval, creating issues, and adding notes through the GitHub REST API, using an external github-rest-api library.

classes.name: githubrestInterface
classes.description: A class for interfacing with GitHub's issue tracking via its REST API, extending issueTrackerInterface and providing methods to connect, retrieve, create issues, and add notes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets default statuses, and establishes a connection to GitHub using provided configuration.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and normalizes configuration attributes needed for API interactions, setting default issue attributes.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the bug ID follows the expected syntax (numeric).

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to GitHub and verifies access by retrieving repository info.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to GitHub is established.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL to view a specific GitHub issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific issue from GitHub.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code (e.g., open or closed) for a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Provides a human-readable status description for an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML-formatted summary of an issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue with the specified ID exists on GitHub.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new GitHub issue with the given summary and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note/comment to an existing GitHub issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template configuration snippet for setting up the GitHub issue tracker integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API, returning true.
